Title: SkyeBrowse updates pricing with new tools for drone 3D mapping
Summary: SkyeBrowse has updated its pricing structure for its drone 3D mapping platform to better cater to the needs of users. The company has introduced three new plans, each designed to suit the specific use cases of teams that capture 3D models with drones. This move is intended to provide more flexibility and affordability for users.

Title: DJI SDR Transmission 2 brings 4K HDR to crowded film sets
Summary: DJI has launched SDR Transmission 2, a wireless video transmission system designed to improve camera feeds in crowded film sets. The system is capable of transmitting 4K HDR video, making it suitable for professional productions. It addresses a common issue on film sets where multiple devices compete for space.
